newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude grades shade lower, API boost outrights.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude grades shade lower, API boost outrights.

text.p: U.S. crudes turned higher after the NYMEX settle, boosted by American Petroleum Institute (API) data showing a large decline in crude stocks and a slight dip in the seasonally sensitive distillates.
Traders said the market looked unsure of itself on an outright basis ahead of the API statistical report. Grades declined from the morning on feelings prices were too steep.

Outrights were initially swayed by pre-opening reports the United Nations may be moving to implement the Iraqi oil-for-food accord, but losses were gradually bought back when no confirmation was seen from the U.S. or U.N.
